name: E2A Basketball Visual Standard v1
status: DEFAULT for every NEW E2A basketball video unless the owner asks for the old look
note: Owner rule 2026-11-23 (HORNS V2): this is the new default visual and editing standard for E2A basketball videos. Born from HORNS: THE DEFENDER'S DILEMMA (produccion/horns-roll-pop-minimal). Merge episode_keys into every new episode generator output; follow the rules below. It does NOT flip the global engine default in code (legacy stays the fallback) and it does NOT change the live Tactical Studio daily task: that switch needs the owner's say-so because it publishes unattended.
characters: Improved 3D athletes via the v33 renderer (athleteRenderer 'v33'): better silhouette, apparel and presence than legacy/v31/v32. v33 compiles motion per player (play key "v33":"compile"); ball-body contact must be 0 (qc-realism-v33.mts).
court_scene: env 'cinema': current court finish and lighting. Keep the clean, professional look; do not add fire, particles, flashes or crowd effects.

overlays.player_markers: Use the 'marker' Ov3 (overlays3d.tsx), not plain 'ring', to point at players: attack = solid gold ring + soft floor glow; defence = thinner white SEGMENTED ring. Shape AND colour differ, so it reads at phone size. One soft ripple on appearance; `focusKeys` lifts the key player.
overlays.legend: Show the 'legend' HUD (ATTACK / DEFENSE key) whenever markers introduce a formation.
overlays.reveal: Introduce the formation by revealing players in sequence (attack, then defence), ~0.15-0.18 s apart.
overlays.routes: Thin routes with a floor label: offence gold, defensive/roll reads in roll_blue. Max 2 tactical overlays on screen at once. White pass line only while the ball is in flight. One-word pins (HELP, STAY, ROLL) and short outcome chips (THREE., LAYUP.).
overlays.limit: Never crowd the screen; every element must help understand the play.

cameras: One clear tactical camera per idea, basket up, behind the offence. Frame with fit-search.mts and VERIFY the whole edit with frame-fit.mts (0 flagged frames in the 380-1330 px safe band). Move the camera only when it adds understanding; no gratuitous orbits/roll. If a zoom pushes any player out of frame, drop it.
rhythm: Calm and clear, but always moving toward a conclusion. No silence longer than ~2.9 s, and any long beat must sit over a real payoff (a shot/finish) with a short on-screen chip, never dead air. Reuse the approved voice take and only insert silences between lines (scripts/tactical-voice.py, gapFill silence); regenerate voice only if strictly necessary.
audio: One calm voice + own minimal music bed (tools/audio/horns_minimal_bed.py or equivalent), ducked under the voice. Mix offline to -14 LUFS +/-1, peak <= -1 dBTP. No ball-bounce sound, squeaks or whooshes.
brand: Palette above; 2026 logo small in the last second.
qa: test-play.mts (claims per line), test-branches.mts when there are branches, qc-realism-v33.mts (ball-body 0), frame-fit.mts (0 flagged), ffprobe + loudness, a 12-frame contact sheet from the final MP4, and a phone-size preview review.
